atoms.text: Mimi is going on a quest to find treasure. Will you help her on her journey?

instruction.text: Mimi wants to sail across the open ocean and avoid any nearby coasts. Sort the images into groups.

hint.text:
Oceans are large bodies of salt water that cover most of Earth.
A coast is an area of land next to the ocean.

instruction.text: Mimi starts in the Pacific Ocean. Can you point it out to her on both sides of the map?

text: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean in the world. The deepest part is called the Mariana Trench, which is even deeper than the tallest mountain!

instruction.text: Using the map, can you count how many continents the Pacific Ocean goes between?

hint.text: Each different coloured area of land is a different continent.

feedback.end: The Pacific Ocean stretches between North America, South America, Asia, and Oceania.

instruction.text: Mimi goes for a swim in the Great Barrier Reef. Select the images of things she might see.

hint.text: The Great Barrier Reef can be found off the coast of Australia and is the largest coral reef in the world. Coral reefs are home to many different fish and other sea species.
hint.label: Great Barrier Reef

instruction.text: Can you remember where the Pacific Ocean is on the map? Drag the labels to the correct places on the image.

hint.text: The Pacific Ocean stretches around the globe and is normally shown on either side of a map.
